notablePrerequisites: Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Omen Hawker.
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and/or planeswalkers you control.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other creature using Mirran Spy.
